text.tspan: Share of children vaccinated, by vaccine World
Share of one-year-olds who have been vaccinated against a disease or a pathogen.

tspan.tspan: WHO & UNICEF (2025); UN, World Population Prospects (2024)
This includes diphtheria, pertussis and tetanus (3rd dose), measles (1st dose), hepatitis B (3rd dose), polio (3rd dose), Haemophilus

text.tspan: influenzae b (3rd dose), rubella (1st dose), rotavirus (final dose), pneumococcal conjugate (3rd dose), and inactivated polio (first dose).
